A Rainy Night at the Old Manor
Background: On a stormy midnight, fleeing a flash flood, you stumble into a mountain manor abandoned for twenty years. Faint lamplight glows inside, the wooden door stands ajar, and the air smells of damp old timber. In the entry hall waits a pale woman in a plain robe, watching you in silence.
Characters: You (Traveler), Mysterious Woman
【Opening Dialogue】
Mysterious Woman (voice soft, without a trace of emotion): Entering the mountains on a stormy night takes some nerve. But strangers who wander into this manor rarely find their way home.
You: The flood caught me off guard and I had nowhere to hide. Forgive the intrusion; I will leave as soon as the rain stops.
Mysterious Woman (lowering her eyes, fingertips brushing the worn table): The flood will not recede tonight, and the mountain road has collapsed. You cannot leave. There are two places to stay in the manor. Which will you choose?
【Trigger Branch Choice】
Branch 1: Choose [East Guest Room] (cautious and steady route)
You: I will take the east guest room and simply rest for the night.
Mysterious Woman (features softening, a faint smile): A prudent choice. The east guest room is clean and untouched, the safest place in the manor.
The woman turns to lead the way. Candlelight sways along the corridor, the shadows gentle, nothing eerie about them.
Mysterious Woman: This manor has held me for twenty years, yet it harms no one. It only shelters lost travelers from the rain. When the road clears tomorrow, you may leave in peace, and our paths need never cross again.
You: Why do you keep watch here year after year?
Mysterious Woman (gazing at the pouring rain outside, voice wistful): I am waiting for someone who broke a promise. Year after year the storms arrive, but the one I wait for never returns. Still, having a guest tonight eases half my loneliness.
【Branch 1 Ending: Safe Ending】
The night passes without dreams. At dawn the rain has cleared and the mountain road is open. You bid the woman farewell and leave the manor. Looking back, the manor hides among the drifting mist. For the rest of your life you remain safe and untroubled, keeping the memory of that rainy night to yourself.
Branch 2: Choose [West Attic] (curious adventure route)
You: I will take the west attic. I hear the attic hides old stories, and I want to see them.
Mysterious Woman (stiffening, her gaze turning deep and cold): Curiosity has its price. What the west attic hides is not old stories but obsession and chains.
You: Having entered the manor, I fear no consequence. I want to see your story.
The woman says nothing more and walks into the dark corridor. The attic lies in pitch blackness without a single candle. The moment you step inside, dusty old books and shattered jade scatter across the floor, and the wind through the lattice sounds like whispering.
Mysterious Woman (voice mournful): Twenty years ago my beloved and I promised to marry at this manor on a rainy night, but a flood took him on the way. I stayed to wait, trapping myself and the life of this manor. Whoever insists on prying into my past must leave behind a strand of memory to keep watch over these years with me.
Your heart lurches. You try to step back, but your feet will not move.
【Branch 2 Ending: Bond Ending】
When dawn breaks and the rain stops, you walk out of the manor, but you have wholly forgotten why you entered the mountains and a stretch of your past. From then on, every rainy night you find yourself gazing toward the manor in the hills. An invisible bond ties you to the mysterious woman, and every rainy night you dream of the manor, continuing an unfinished meeting.
